nodes.description: Timestamp when the Lockable contract was deployed, set to now in the constructor.
Public boolean lock flag declared in Lockable (never written in this code).
Global flag controlling whether token transfers are allowed; toggled by enableTokenTransfer/disableTokenTransfer.
Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at construction and used by the isOwner modifier.
Mapping of addresses exempted from the disabled token-transfer state; checked in isTokenTransfer.
Mapping of locked addresses; asserted false in the checkLock modifier.
Constant token name 'YGGDRASH'.
Constant token symbol 'YEED'.
Constant token decimals, 18.
Core balance mapping address => uint, read and written by transfer, transferFrom, burnTokens and balanceOf.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => uint used by approve, allowance and transferFrom.
Total token supply, set in the constructor and reduced in burnTokens.
Privileged wallet address allowed to enable/disable token transfers via onlyFromWallet.
Constructor of Lockable: sets creationTime = now, tokenTransfer = false and owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only external function adding/removing an address from the lockaddress mapping.
Owner-only external function adding/removing an address from the unlockaddress mapping.
SafeMath multiply: computes a * b and asserts no overflow.
SafeMath divide: computes a / b.
SafeMath subtract: asserts b <= a then returns a - b.
SafeMath add: computes a + b and asserts no overflow.
Returns the larger of two uint64 values.
Returns the smaller of two uint64 values.
Returns the larger of two uint256 values.
Returns the smaller of two uint256 values.
Token constructor: requires non-zero wallet and initial balance, credits msg.sender, sets _supply and walletAddress.
Returns the current _supply value.
Returns the balance of the supplied address from _balances.
Returns the remaining allowance an owner granted to a spender.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient; gated by isTokenTransfer and checkLock modifiers.
Transfers tokens on behalf of another address using allowance; gated by isTokenTransfer and checkLock.
Sets the allowance msg.sender grants to spender; gated by checkLock.
Burns tokensAmount from the caller's balance and reduces _supply; gated by isTokenTransfer.
External function setting tokenTransfer = true; callable only by walletAddress via onlyFromWallet.
External function setting tokenTransfer = false; callable only by walletAddress via onlyFromWallet.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts any ether sent to the contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance indexes and allowance lookups.
Block timestamp (now) used to initialise creationTime, introducing a miner-influenced value.
Raw multiplication uint c = a * b in SafeMath.mul, checked only by an assert.
Raw division uint c = a / b in SafeMath.div.
Raw subtraction a - b in SafeMath.sub, guarded by assert(b <= a).
Raw addition a + b in SafeMath.add, guarded by assert(c >= a).
_balances[msg.sender].sub(value) inside transfer.
_balances[to].add(value) inside transfer.
_approvals[from][msg.sender].sub(value) inside transferFrom.
_balances[from].sub(value) inside transferFrom.
_balances[to].add(value) inside transferFrom.
_balances[msg.sender].sub(tokensAmount) inside burnTokens.
_supply.sub(tokensAmount) inside burnTokens reducing total supply.
value parameter of YeedToken.transfer: amount to move.
to parameter of YeedToken.transfer: recipient address.
from parameter of YeedToken.transferFrom: debited address.
spender parameter of YeedToken.approve.
owner parameter of YeedToken.allowance.
who parameter of YeedToken.balanceOf.
a parameter shared by the SafeMath helper functions.
b parameter shared by the SafeMath helper functions.
target parameter of Lockable.lockAddress.
status parameter of Lockable.lockAddress and unlockAddress.
initial_balance parameter of the YeedToken constructor.
wallet parameter of the YeedToken constructor, stored as walletAddress.
tokensAmount parameter of YeedToken.burnTokens.
Local result variable c in SafeMath.mul holding a * b.
Local result variable c in SafeMath.div holding a / b.
Local result variable c in SafeMath.add holding a + b.

edges.reason: Lockable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and isOwner requires owner == msg.sender.
isTokenTransfer modifier requires unlockaddress[msg.sender] to bypass a disabled transfer state.
checkLock modifier asserts !lockaddress[msg.sender] before every transfer.
msg.sender indexes the _balances mapping in the constructor, transfer and burnTokens.
msg.sender indexes _approvals in approve and transferFrom.
onlyFromWallet requires msg.sender != walletAddress for enable/disableTokenTransfer.
enableTokenTransfer is gated by onlyFromWallet against walletAddress.
disableTokenTransfer is gated by onlyFromWallet against walletAddress.
creationTime = now stores a miner-influenced timestamp value.
Lockable constructor sets creationTime = now.
Lockable constructor initialises tokenTransfer = false.
Lockable constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
lockAddress writes lockaddress[target] under the isOwner modifier.
unlockAddress writes unlockaddress[target] under the isOwner modifier.
SafeMath.mul executes the raw multiplication uint c = a * b.
SafeMath.div executes the raw division uint c = a / b.
SafeMath.sub returns a - b after assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add executes uint c = a + b with overflow assert.
transfer subtracts value from the sender balance using SafeMath.sub.
transfer adds value to the recipient balance using SafeMath.add.
transferFrom subtracts the approved amount from _approvals.
transferFrom subtracts value from the from balance.
transferFrom adds value to the recipient balance.
burnTokens subtracts tokensAmount from the caller balance.
burnTokens decreases _supply by tokensAmount.
transfer delegates balance deduction to SafeMath.sub.
transfer delegates balance credit to SafeMath.add.
transferFrom delegates subtractions to SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient credit to SafeMath.add.
burnTokens delegates both subtractions to SafeMath.sub.
YeedToken constructor credits initial_balance to _balances[msg.sender].
YeedToken constructor sets _supply = initial_balance.
YeedToken constructor stores walletAddress = wallet after a zero-address check.
transfer mutates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates _balances for from and to.
transferFrom reduces _approvals[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance into _approvals[msg.sender][spender].
burnTokens mutates _balances[msg.sender].
burnTokens mutates _supply.
balanceOf reads _balances[who].
allowance reads _approvals[owner][spender].
totalSupply returns _supply.
enableTokenTransfer sets the global tokenTransfer flag to true.
disableTokenTransfer sets the global tokenTransfer flag to false.
isTokenTransfer modifier gates transfer on the tokenTransfer flag.
isTokenTransfer modifier gates transferFrom on the tokenTransfer flag.
isTokenTransfer modifier gates burnTokens on the tokenTransfer flag.
isOwner modifier checks owner == msg.sender before lockAddress writes.
isOwner modifier checks owner == msg.sender before unlockAddress writes.
value parameter feeds the transfer routine.
to parameter feeds the transfer recipient balance update.
from parameter feeds the transferFrom debit path.
spender parameter keys the approve allowance write.
owner parameter keys the allowance read.
who parameter keys the balanceOf read.
a parameter feeds the raw multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
b parameter feeds the raw multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
target parameter selects the lockaddress entry to modify.
status parameter is written into the lockaddress mapping.
initial_balance parameter sets _balances and _supply.
wallet parameter is validated and stored as walletAddress.
tokensAmount parameter drives the burn computation.
value flows into the sender balance subtraction.
tokensAmount flows into the caller balance subtraction.
from flows into the debited balance subtraction.
Local c in SafeMath.mul receives the multiplication result.
Local c in SafeMath.div receives the division result.
Local c in SafeMath.add receives the addition result.
